name: Windowpane
description: Frame-window analysis for Geometry Dash macros: per-click timing windows at 240 Hz, a live counter, click markers and a σ/s difficulty rating.

enabled.name: Enable mod
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, nothing is drawn and no hooks do any work.

show-normal.name: Show in normal attempts
show-normal.description: Show the sidebar and markers in ordinary (non-practice) attempts.

show-practice.name: Show in practice mode
show-practice.description: Show the sidebar and markers in practice mode.

show-playback.name: Show during macro playback
show-playback.description: Show the sidebar and markers when an analyzed macro is loaded.

key-toggle-sidebar.name: Toggle sidebar hotkey
key-toggle-sidebar.description: Shows / hides the counter sidebar during a level.

key-analyze.name: Start / cancel analysis hotkey
key-analyze.description: Starts analysing the loaded macro, or cancels a running analysis.

tps-note.description: Windows are counted in physics ticks. Display FPS only changes screen redraws.
tps-note.name: Note

frame-limiter.name: Apply display FPS
frame-limiter.description: Sets the game's frame interval to the display FPS below. Off keeps your FPS settings.

display-fps-custom.name: Custom display FPS
display-fps-custom.description: Used when Display FPS is set to custom.

sidebar-enabled.name: Show sidebar
sidebar-enabled.description: The stacked window counter (highest bucket on top).

sidebar-corner.name: Position
sidebar-corner.description: Screen corner the sidebar is anchored to.

sidebar-margin-x.name: Margin X (% of width)
sidebar-margin-x.description: Distance from the left/right edge. Default is about 1.5% of the screen width.

sidebar-custom-x.name: Custom X (% of width)
sidebar-custom-x.description: Only used when Position is Custom. Measured from the left edge.

sidebar-custom-y.name: Custom Y (% of height)
sidebar-custom-y.description: Used when Position is Custom. Distance from the bottom edge to the first row.

sidebar-text-scale.name: Text scale
sidebar-text-scale.description: Scale of the bigFont text. 0.5 matches the reference screenshot.

sidebar-row-spacing.name: Row spacing (% of height)
sidebar-row-spacing.description: Vertical distance between rows. 7% matches the reference screenshot.

sidebar-align.name: Alignment
sidebar-align.description: Left: two left-aligned columns. Right: labels end at the counts. Center: centred labels.

sidebar-font.name: Font
sidebar-font.description: Bitmap font used for the rows.

sidebar-outline.name: Extra outline (px)
sidebar-outline.description: Thickens the text outline with extra black copies behind the text.

show-zero-rows.name: Show rows with zero count
show-zero-rows.description: When off, a row is hidden until its count is above zero.

extended-rows.name: Extended rows (13-15, 16+)
extended-rows.description: Auto: appear only when their count is above 0. Always / Never override that.

count-style.name: Count style
count-style.description: Count: number. Count / Total: out of the total. Percent: share of analysed inputs.

show-total-row.name: Show total row
show-total-row.description: Adds a final row with the total number of inputs counted.

sidebar-anim.name: Show / hide animation
sidebar-anim.description: How the sidebar appears and disappears.

show-sigma.name: Show σ/s line
show-sigma.description: Adds a difficulty line at the bottom of the sidebar.

sigma-hours.name: Assumed completion hours
sigma-hours.description: The expected time to complete the level from 0% used by the σ/s model.

timings.name: Timings to show
timings.description: Window sizes to count, comma separated: 4, 5-6, 16+. Colours come from the bucket rows.

rank-colours.name: Colour from easiest to hardest
rank-colours.description: Shown timings go from light purple (easiest) to red (hardest), whatever their numbers. Off: row colours.

t-35.name: Bucket editor
t-35.description: Up to nine rows. Ranges: 5, 5-6 or 16+. The highest range is drawn on top.

row-1-visible.name: Row 1 visible
row-1-visible.description: Untick to remove this row entirely.

row-1-range.name: Row 1 range
row-1-range.description: Window sizes counted in this row. Blank disables the row.

row-1-label.name: Row 1 label
row-1-label.description: Text before the colon. Blank uses the range text.

row-1-extended.name: Row 1 is an extended row
row-1-extended.description: Extended rows follow the Extended rows mode above.

row-1-marker-color.name: Row 1 marker number colour
row-1-marker-color.description: Colour of the window number next to click markers.

nan-enabled.name: Show caption
nan-enabled.description: Small grey text directly under the vanilla percentage label.

nan-text.name: Text
nan-text.description: Leave blank to hide the text.

nan-smallcaps.name: Small caps
nan-smallcaps.description: Capital letters are drawn larger than the rest, like the reference.

marker-enabled.name: Show markers
marker-enabled.description: Shows a ring with the window number where each analysed input happened.

marker-size.name: Size
marker-size.description: Multiplier on the default size (9% of the screen height).

marker-outline-color.name: Outline colour
marker-outline-color.description: Colour of the outlines around ring and centre.

marker-number-pos.name: Number position
marker-number-pos.description: Where the window number sits relative to the ring.

marker-number-size.name: Number size
marker-number-size.description: Multiplier on the window number size.

marker-text-distance.name: Number distance
marker-text-distance.description: Gap between number and ring, in ring widths. Negative moves it onto the ring.

frame-sounds.name: Frame sounds
frame-sounds.description: Plays frame-N.wav for each analysed input during playback (9 and up use frame-9).

marker-lifetime.name: Lifetime (seconds)
marker-lifetime.description: 0 keeps a marker until it scrolls off screen.

marker-fade.name: Fade out
marker-fade.description: Fade markers instead of popping them.

marker-filter-below.name: Only windows below N
marker-filter-below.description: 0 shows every marker. Otherwise only inputs whose window is smaller than N.

marker-max.name: Max markers on screen
marker-max.description: Pool size. Older markers are recycled first.

readout-enabled.name: Show readout
readout-enabled.description: Small white outlined text in the bottom-left corner: progress % and run time.

readout-time.name: Show run time
readout-time.description: Adds the run time under the percentage.

readout-y.name: Y (% of height)
readout-y.description: Distance from the bottom edge to the lower line.

decimals.name: Decimals
decimals.description: Digits after the point for window numbers. CBF mode uses at least 2.

auto-timing.name: Fix imported macro timing
auto-timing.description: If an imported macro dies early, other frame numberings are tried and the best is used.

exact-replay.name: Exact replay from the start
exact-replay.description: Replays every trial from the start (macros up to 30 s). Longer ones use snapshots.

record-stitch.name: Recording: respawn at practice checkpoints
record-stitch.description: On: respawn at your last practice checkpoint the normal way (the game's own checkpoints). Off: every death restarts at 0%.

rebuild-hide-screen.name: Hide whole screen during respawn
rebuild-hide-screen.description: On: the whole screen is hidden while a checkpoint respawn is rebuilt (beta 2). Off: only the level objects.

auto-repair.name: Repair macros that die
auto-repair.description: Moves the clicks nearest to a death by a few ticks until a macro that dies early survives.

repair-max-shift.name: Repair: max click move (ticks)
repair-max-shift.description: How far a click may be moved while repairing a macro.

keep-hold.name: Move the release with the click
keep-hold.description: A shifted click moves its release too, so the hold length stays the same.

release-timing.name: Release timings
release-timing.description: Auto: only where releases matter. Always: every release. Never: clicks only.

subtick-auto.name: Half-tick measurement (experimental)
subtick-auto.description: Also tries clicks between ticks when the game counts several steps per tick.

cbf-mode.name: CBF mode (sub-tick clicks)
cbf-mode.description: Measures windows in fractions of a tick. Needs a game build that honours click timestamps.

analysis-speed.name: Speed (x real time)
analysis-speed.description: Target speed in multiples of real time. Higher is faster if your PC keeps up.

auto-throttle.name: Auto-throttle
auto-throttle.description: Slows down when frames get long and ramps back up afterwards.

min-fps.name: Minimum FPS while analysing
min-fps.description: The analysis never spends more than 1/this per frame.

max-shift.name: Max shift each side (ticks)
max-shift.description: How far an input is moved before it counts as 'unbounded'. 5 matches the reference frame window counter (it never looks past 5 ticks each way, so a click with 5 ticks of room on both sides is an 11-tick window and is not counted in the 1-10 rows). Raise it to measure wider windows.

max-trials.name: Max trials per input
max-trials.description: Hard cap on re-simulations for one input.

horizon-inputs.name: Survive next N inputs
horizon-inputs.description: A shifted input must survive this many later inputs, plus the tail below.

horizon-tail.name: Tail after last input (ticks)
horizon-tail.description: Extra ticks that must be survived.

horizon-min.name: Minimum horizon (ticks)
horizon-min.description: Shortest section checked for a trial.

horizon-max.name: Maximum horizon (ticks)
horizon-max.description: Longest section checked for a trial. Also the infinite-loop guard.

fly-strictness.name: Ship / wave / swing strictness
fly-strictness.description: 0 = same as other modes. Each step checks one more click after a click in ship / wave / swing.

converge-ticks.name: Convergence ticks
converge-ticks.description: A trial ends early after matching the original run for this many ticks in a row.

rejoin-extra.name: Keep checking while off-course (ticks)
rejoin-extra.description: Extra ticks checked past the horizon while a shifted run is still off course. 0 = off.

verify-boundaries.name: Re-check every window edge
verify-boundaries.description: Replays the edge of each window to the end with no early exit. Lowers it if it dies.

recheck-tight.name: Re-check tight clicks at the end
recheck-tight.description: Measures every click with a window of 1-3 ticks once more at the end, strictly. Slower.

fidelity-selftest.name: Snapshot self-test
fidelity-selftest.description: Re-simulates 16 ticks twice from each snapshot to check both runs match.

fidelity-longselftest.name: Check snapshots over the whole trial
fidelity-longselftest.description: Checks snapshots over a whole trial. Bad snapshots fall back to replaying from the start.

local-start.name: Start trials just before the click
local-start.description: When a snapshot does not restore bit-exactly, still start each trial from it (a few ticks before the click) and set the player's position, velocity and rotation to what the first pass had there, instead of replaying from an earlier snapshot or from the start. Much faster deeper into a level.

fast-search.name: Fast window search
fast-search.description: Shifts 1-8 are tried one by one as before; past 8 the search jumps outwards and bisects, so wide windows need far fewer trials. Turn off to try every shift one by one.

mute-analysis.name: Mute audio while analysing
mute-analysis.description: Recommended: checkpoint loads would otherwise seek the music thousands of times.

screenshot-mode.name: Screenshot mode
screenshot-mode.description: Hides pause and practice buttons and attempt labels, leaving the sidebar and markers.

btn-save-json.name: Save results now
btn-save-json.description: Writes the JSON for the current results.

btn-copy-summary.name: Copy summary
btn-copy-summary.description: Copies a text summary of the current results to the clipboard.

btn-open-folder.name: Macros folder
btn-open-folder.description: Opens the folder Windowpane reads macros from.
